headline: House sends Russia sanctions bill to Trump's desk
summary: The House voted 262-159 Wednesday for a package of sanctions on Russian officials, banks and the tanker fleet that moves its oil. It also lets Trump put tariffs of up to 100% on the top five buyers of Russian oil and gas. The bill is named for the late Sen. Lindsey Graham, who spent more than a year on it. The Senate passed it last month.
cover_answer: Oil money pays for Putin's war. Fewer buyers, less cash.
table_question: Would you hand someone a tool if you didn't trust how they'd use it?

5-7.chip: Bring it up if it fits the day
5-7.script: Russia has been fighting a war against its neighbor Ukraine. Yesterday lawmakers in Washington voted to make it harder for Russia to sell its oil and get money. It's like cutting off a bully's allowance so he can't keep buying what he needs. The grown-ups are working on it.
5-7.why: A war is too big for a six-year-old. An allowance being cut off is not.

8-12.chip: Bring it up if it fits the day
8-12.script: Russia sells oil to pay for its war on Ukraine. The House passed a bill hitting Russian banks and oil tankers, and letting Trump put tariffs of up to 100% on the biggest buyers of that oil. Fewer buyers, less money for the war. A penalty: you can't stop the play, so you make it cost.
8-12.why: Oil to money to war is one chain they can follow.

13-17.script: Why punish the oil buyers? That is the bill: sanctions on Russian banks and tankers, plus tariffs of up to 100% Trump can put on the top buyers of Russian oil. Democratic leaders voted no, not over Ukraine, but over handing Trump more tariff power.
13-17.why: Teens can hold two goods in tension. Let them find the catch.
